Hospitality Management

CH on Peel Pty Ltd is looking for another full-time member for its management team. Situated in the heart of Tamworth, our operations include the 62 room CH Boutique Hotel, the heritage listed DECO Wine Bar & Restaurant, Hopscotch Restaurant, the Pavilion Function & Conference Centre, Pig & Tinder Box Restaurant & Bar, The Bureau, and the Dungowan Brewery. All our restaurants are full service dine in establishments.

The Position

You will have an opportunity to further develop your hospitality skills and experience work in a variety of areas across our food service sites. The position includes managerial level food and beverage duties and bar work. This position is suited for candidates that like to work in a fast-paced supportive team environment, with high quality table service experience preferred. The successful applicant must be available across a 7 day roster including nights and weekends.

As a member of our management team, you will be responsible for the overall running of the business from top to bottom, leading by example and maintaining high standards. You must be highly motivated and able to manage all operational elements of the business from front to back of house. You will be passionate about your job, have a superior knowledge of food and beverage, understand the order of service and ensure our clients leave having had an all-round unforgettable dining experience.

Key Duties

* Delivering exceptional Customer Service
* Maintaining the service area
* Knowledge of Food Safety requirements
* Understanding of liquor licensing laws and compliance
* Proven record managing restaurants and meeting KPI targets
* Proven financial management capabilities
* Arranging bespoke events
* Experience in training staff with cultural sensitivity
* Working with our chefs to update and improve menus
* Overseeing of rostering
* Selecting and training restaurant and service staff
* Stock level management
* Cash handling and register operation

The Person

* RSA Certificate Essential
* Diploma in Hospitality Operations or Similar desirable
* Previous Bar experience
* Be able to work independently
* Experience in a fast-paced hospitality environment
* Great presentation and customer service skills
* Willingness to be part of an enthusiastic and motivated team
* Willingness to jump into any task required, cleaning, food preparation and customer service
* Strong awareness of Hygiene & Food Safety Standards
* Must always be well presented, have a great work ethic and the ability to perform well under pressure
* A Positive can-do attitude and the ability to work nights & weekends

So, if you are a 'can-do' person, who thrives on new challenges; likes working in a team environment; and consistently delivers to the highest quality, then you'll fit right in and we'd like to have you on our team.

Salary package: $63,000 - $73,000 per annum plus Super depending on skills and experience

result.description:
Position Title: Retail Manager
Location: Kilkenny, South Australia
Employment Type: Full-time (38 hours per week)
Salary: $80,000 per annum + superannuation


About the Company

HHHLJ PTY LTD (as the trustee of Le Huynh Family Trust ABN 48 539 316 778 ) trading as Arndale Bakery is a South Australian family-owned bakery and wholesale supplier based in Kilkenny, providing a wide range of freshly baked products to restaurants, caterers, cafés and the local community. The business is committed to delivering consistent quality, reliable service and products that meet the needs of both commercial customers and local consumers.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to oversee the day-to- day operations of Arndale Bakery’s retail outlet. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the retail team, maintaining high standards of customer service, managing stock and product presentation, supporting sales growth, and ensuring efficient store operations. This role is suited to a hands-on leader who can create a positive team environment and deliver an excellent experience for customers.


Key Responsibilities

- Plan, organise and manage the day-to-day operations of the bakery’s retail outlet.
- Determine the appropriate product range, stock levels, pricing and customer service standards.
- Monitor sales performance, operating costs and financial results to support business growth and profitability.
- Prepare and manage store budgets, sales targets and operational expenditure.
- Develop and implement purchasing, promotional and marketing strategies.
- Manage inventory, place orders and maintain accurate records of stock movements and financial transactions.
- Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers, commercial customers and service providers.
- Recruit, train, roster, supervise and evaluate retail employees.
- Provide leadership and guidance to staff while maintaining a positive and productive workplace.
- Ensure customers receive professional service and appropriate advice regarding bakery products and orders.
- Manage customer feedback, complaints and service issues in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain high standards of product presentation, store cleanliness and merchandising.
- Ensure the retail outlet complies with food safety, workplace health and safety and other applicable operational requirements.
- Review store procedures and implement improvements to increase efficiency, sales and customer satisfaction.
- Coordinate with the bakery production team to ensure product availability, quality and timely fulfilment of customer orders.


Requirements

- Diploma-level qualification in retail management, business, hospitality or a related field, or at least three years of relevant management experience.
- Proven experience managing a retail store, bakery, café or similar business.
- Strong leadership skills, including staff supervision, rostering and training.
- Experience managing sales, budgets, stock, purchasing and supplier relationships.
- Excellent customer service, communication and problem-solving skills.
- Knowledge of food safety, workplace health and safety and retail operations.


How to Apply

Please submit your resume to resumes@wearefulcrum.com and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

result.description:
Sunup Farm at Spring Creek, Queensland, is a certified organic horticultural grower that cultivates and supplies fresh produce to markets across the region. The business runs the full growing cycle in house, from crop production and irrigation through to harvesting, packing and dispatch, and holds organic certification across a broad range of vegetable and fruit lines. With a firm commitment to product quality, workplace safety, sustainable growing practices and employment within the regional community, Sunup Farm is looking for an experienced Quality Assurance Manager to join the team. As Sunup Farm continues to grow and to uphold the standards behind its certifications, we are bringing quality assurance and food safety under dedicated leadership. Reporting to management, the Quality Assurance Manager will take ownership of the systems, standards and everyday checks that keep our produce safe, consistent and compliant, from the paddock through to the packing shed and on to our customers.

In this role you will:
•	Build and maintain the farm's quality assurance and food safety management systems, so every line of produce consistently meets the standards our customers and certifiers expect.
•	Identify the food safety standards, organic certification requirements and regulatory codes that apply to our operation, and turn them into clear, practical operating procedures the team can follow each day.
•	Set quality objectives and workable plans that keep customers satisfied while making efficient use of the farm's people, water, inputs and equipment.
•	Plan and run internal audits, and coordinate external and certification audits, so the business stays inspection ready throughout the year.
•	Use quality checks, data and monitoring tools to track produce quality from the field through grading, packing and dispatch, and step in quickly when results drift outside acceptable limits.
•	Investigate non-conformances, quality issues and customer complaints, identify the root cause, and put corrective and preventive actions in place so problems do not recur.
•	Keep quality documentation, records and reporting systems accurate and current, including full batch traceability from paddock to customer.
•	Oversee hygiene, sanitation and safe food-handling practices across the packing shed, cool rooms and produce-handling areas, and keep cleaning and pest-control programmes on track.
•	Carry out pre-harvest and post-harvest inspections and product grading, confirming that fruit and vegetables meet quality specifications before they are packed and shipped.
•	Monitor storage and cool-chain conditions so freshness and shelf life are protected from harvest right through to delivery.
•	Maintain records of approved inputs and treatment activity in line with organic certification, and verify that incoming materials and supplier products meet our requirements.
•	Review how we grow, harvest, pack and dispatch, looking for practical improvements to systems, processes and workflows that lift consistency and reduce waste.
•	Train and support farm and packing staff on quality procedures, food safety and compliance, building good practice into everyday work.
•	Act as the main point of contact on quality matters for management, auditors, regulators and customers, keeping each informed on performance and compliance.
•	Champion continuous-improvement initiatives across production and operations, encouraging a culture where quality is everyone's responsibility.

About you:
•	At least 2 years of relevant experience in quality assurance, food safety or quality management, ideally gained in horticulture, fresh produce, food manufacturing or a related industry.
•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in food science, agricultural science, quality management or a related discipline.

Personal attributes:
•	Strong attention to detail with a methodical, organised approach to records, checks and reporting.
•	A confident communicator who can train staff and work comfortably with auditors, regulators and customers.
•	Sound problem-solving skills and a calm considered manner when quality issues arise.
•	Hands-on and approachable, at ease moving between the office, the packing shed and the field.
•	High standards of integrity and accountability, with a genuine commitment to food safety and quality.

Salary and employment conditions:
•	Permanent, full-time position of 38 hours per week.
•	$75,000 to $80,000 plus superannuation per annum.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! Please be sure to combine a covering letter addressing the key criteria set out above as the first page of your resume.

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a results-driven and commercially minded ICT Business Development Manager to join our team and play a pivotal role in expanding our market presence across Australia. This role is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities within the ICT sector, while nurturing existing client relationships to drive sustained revenue growth. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of ICT products and services, a consultative sales approach, and a proven track record of exceeding targets. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, aligning our solutions with their evolving technology needs.
## Key Responsibilities
- Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities within the ICT sector, building a robust pipeline of prospective clients across target industries.
- Visit and engage with both existing and prospective client organisations to understand their ICT environments, uncover challenges, and present tailored solutions that address their specific needs.
- Develop and execute strategic business development plans in alignment with organisational goals, market trends, and revenue targets.
- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and senior leaders across client accounts.
- Promote and articulate the value of the organisation's ICT goods and services to clients through presentations, proposals, demonstrations, and consultative discussions.
- Assess and analyse customer requirements to recommend appropriate products, services, and technology solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
- Manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
- Collaborate closely with internal technical, pre-sales, and delivery teams to develop compelling proposals and ensure seamless handover upon deal closure.
- Monitor market activity, competitor offerings, and emerging ICT trends to inform go-to-market strategies and maintain a competitive edge.
- Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms in line with company policies and client expectations, ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities, pipeline status, and client interactions within the CRM system.
- Report regularly on business development performance, forecasting, and market insights to senior leadership.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Commerce, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, or account management within the ICT industry.
- Strong understanding of ICT products, services, and solutions, including areas such as cloud computing, networking, cybersecurity, managed services, or software.
- Proven ability to develop and manage a sales pipeline, meeting or exceeding revenue targets consistently.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage confidently at all organisational levels.
- Consultative sales approach with the ability to understand complex client needs and translate them into viable technology solutions.
- Highly organised and self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
- Proficiency in CRM platforms and standard business productivity tools.
- Valid Australian driver's licence and willingness to travel for client meetings as required.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant ICT certifications such as ITIL, AWS, Microsoft, or Cisco credentials.
- Experience managing government, enterprise, or large commercial accounts within the Australian market.
- Familiarity with procurement processes, tender submissions, and responding to Requests for Proposal (RFPs).
- Postgraduate qualifications in Business Administration, Sales, or Technology Management.
- Established professional network within the Australian ICT sector.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation at the forefront of ICT innovation, where your contributions directly influence business growth and strategy.
- Enjoy a flexible and supportive work environment that values work-life balance and invests in the wellbeing of its people.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including industry certifications, training programmes, and career advancement pathways.
- Benefit from a competitive remuneration package with performance-based incentives that reward your results.
- Join a collaborative and inclusive team culture where ideas are valued, excellence is recognised, and success is shared.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Restaurant Manager to lead our Food & Beverage operations.

Lead, coach and develop the front-of-house team.
Prepare staff rosters and manage labour costs.
Coordinate restaurant bookings, functions and special events.
Work closely with the Executive Chef to maintain high food and service standards.
Monitor stock ordering, inventory control and monthly stocktakes.
Ensure compliance with Food Safety, RSA and WHS requirements.
Manage POS systems, cash handling and end-of-day reconciliation.
Handle member enquiries and resolve issues professionally.
Monitor budgets and contribute to achieving financial targets.

Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience.
Strong leadership and communication skills.
Experience in restaurant, hotel or club operations.
Knowledge of food, wine and beverage service.
Experience with rostering, budgeting and stock control.
Excellent presentation and customer service skills.

Why Join The Queen’s Club?
Work for one of Sydney’s most respected private clubs.
Competitive salary package.
Career development opportunities.
Supportive management team.
Staff meals provided while on duty.
CBD location close to public transport.
Stable, full-time position with an established organisation.
